remarks: Soaring ceilings, abundant natural light and fresh updates throughout make this a perfect place to call home! This happy home is located at the end of a centrally-located cul de sac close to everything Westport has to offer, including just a mile to schools. Updated kitchen and baths, efficient natural gas heat and cooled by central air conditioning. The generously-sized back deck overlooks a large, level and dry private yard ready for barbeques and lazy afternoons. The lower level is fully finished and is a bright space with custom built-in cabinetry and storage, and a good-sized mudroom. Gleaming hardwood floors throughout. Just pack your bags and move right in to 3 Donald Drive!
